name: Defilade
summary: Defilade is an old-school isometric RTS set in modern warfare. Command intelligent troops that take cover, rescue wounded comrades, dive from grenades, vault obstacles and dig trenches. Build your forces, secure supply lines and fight across fully destructible massive battlefields that feel alive.
